content.text: Section 24 fully satisfies the preferred position, and no other clause creates a change-of-control right for the Vendor.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 matches our preferred position in full: 24.1 gives Customer an affiliate/successor assignment right without Vendor consent (notice only); 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (reasonableness-qualified) and never to a direct Customer competitor; 24.3 applies a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard to other assignments; and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control. A document-wide search for "assign" and "change of control" found no competing restriction or Vendor exit/repricing trigger elsewhere (Section 13 licence transfer rights track Section 24; Section 9 references only insolvency-type general assignments). No redline needed.
